Resolves #22041
Related: #21942, #21346, neomjs/pages#197

The Sprint Board card used to show a close-up of two columns. Its caption promised a second view of the same records, but the table was outside the crop. Removing the old scroll-and-crop recipe lets the ordinary camera show the board and its **All cards** table together. Ten existing catalog records gain `hasLightCover`.

[Pages #197](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/197) has merged. I downloaded all twenty images from both the public site and the Portal’s image host after the [production deployment](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/actions/runs/45091200711). Every SHA-256 matched the reviewed Pages blobs.

Evidence: L3 (stock captures, real Portal theme switches, image decoding, and a pointer drag updating the visible table) → L3 required.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Proof |
| --- | --- |
| 1 · Board opening | The stock CLI with the obsolete rule removed produced dark and light 1280 × 720 images from 960 × 540 openings with zero input steps. A real drag of “Design the login form” from Backlog to Ready changed the matching table row at desktop and phone viewport widths. [Board after drag](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ae1dbed88fbfa21e72ece515bff1ff0e05dfa5d5/review-evidence/22041/board-drag.png). |
| 2 · Availability | The [census and per-card hashes](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ae1dbed88fbfa21e72ece515bff1ff0e05dfa5d5/review-evidence/22041/verified-covers.json) identify every baseline record, every tested URL and all ten new pairs. All 262 earlier publicly referenced files matched the pinned Pages blobs. All 74 previously verified original records retain their exact image and availability flag. All twenty new files now match the reviewed assets on both hosts. |
| 3 · Render | In Chromium, the normal theme control selected and decoded the correct 1280 × 720 JPEG for all ten changed cards in both palettes (20/20). | 4 · Broader backfill | Nine of these records were in the original 143 and Task Worker is newer. If the batch lands in full, the original set becomes 83 paired, 59 unpaired and one retired. The unfinished records and their source/design decisions stay on #21942. |

## Deltas from ticket

The nine previously recipe-free examples only gain the availability flag. Sprint Board loses its old example-specific scroll step, selector assertions and crop configuration; its application code is unchanged.

## Test Evidence

96 Portal catalog and camera unit tests and all five cover-theme Chromium cases passed. The paired Board hero receives its light image. The compatibility control supplies older catalog data through a dedicated App worker and confirms it requests only the base file across a switch. The supported stock camera produced 95,267-byte dark and 97,583-byte light Board openings. The independent stock-camera run and the actual source branch produced identical pairs. [Full per-record browser and catalog evidence](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ae1dbed88fbfa21e72ece515bff1ff0e05dfa5d5/review-evidence/22041/verified-covers.json).

Two context-free readers graded the unlabelled pages in swapped order. Reader 1 gave the baseline **6/10** and the candidate **8/10**. Reader 2 gave the candidate **8/10** and the baseline **7/10**. Both could recognize the same card in the board and table in the new hero.

Frame critique: the previous crop made the orange work-in-progress limit clearer, but hid the table entirely. The new hero makes shared data visible at card size; the rightmost board columns and table fields extend past the edge. The examples still support horizontal scrolling.
